{'index': 0, 'text': 'The highly anticipated Apple TV+ series "Ted Lasso" is currently in the middle of its fourth season, and the response has been overwhelming — but three other exciting new shows are about to land very soon.'}

{'index': 1, 'text': 'Show one: Dark Matter'}

{'index': 2, 'text': "Apple TV+ has a treasure trove of great series for sci-fi fans to binge. While Severance and Pluribus have already become the talk of the town, there's one deeply beloved series that may have flown under the radar: Dark Matter."}

{'index': 3, 'text': 'Adapted from the bestselling novel by Blake Crouch, the series stars Joel Edgerton and Jennifer Connelly.'}

{'index': 4, 'text': 'Dark Matter season 2 premieres on Friday, 28 August, with new episodes dropping weekly through to 30 October.'}

{'index': 5, 'text': "Here's the synopsis from Apple:"}

{'index': 6, 'text': 'Show two: Mayday'}

{'index': 7, 'text': "Apple TV+'s autumn slate is a packed one, with most titles heading straight to streaming instead of getting a theatrical release first."}

{'index': 8, 'text': 'Kicking things off is Mayday, an action comedy starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh that puts a fresh spin on the classic spy thriller.'}

{'index': 9, 'text': 'Mayday lands exclusively on Apple TV+ on Friday, 4 September.'}

{'index': 10, 'text': "Here's the synopsis and trailer from Apple:"}

{'index': 11, 'text': 'Show three: Slow Horses'}

{'index': 12, 'text': "One of Apple's most acclaimed series, Slow Horses, is making its return."}

{'index': 13, 'text': 'In the streaming era, fans often have to wait years between seasons of their favourite shows. But Slow Horses has stuck to a yearly release schedule, with Gary Oldman leading the team as Jackson Lamb in another gripping instalment of spy action.'}

{'index': 14, 'text': 'Slow Horses season 6 premieres on Wednesday, 16 September, with new episodes dropping weekly through to 21 October.'}

{'index': 15, 'text': 'Apple TV+ costs US$12.99 per month, or you can bundle it at a discount through the Apple One subscription plan.'}
